tasks.name: slugify-fixture
tasks.prompt: Create adaptive-benchmark-fixture.mjs exporting slugify(text). Trim whitespace, lowercase ASCII, replace runs of characters other than ASCII letters and digits with a hyphen, and strip leading/trailing hyphens. Return an empty string when no letters or digits remain. Do not add dependencies. Verify the examples Hello World -> hello-world and --- -> empty string.

args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {slugify} from './adaptive-benchmark-fixture.mjs'; assert.equal(slugify(' Hello, World! '), 'hello-world'); assert.equal(slugify('---'), ''); assert.equal(slugify('A___B  42'), 'a-b-42');
